candidates.statement: Let A be a commutative DG ring. The action from Proposition 2.5(1) makes D(A) into an H0(A)-linear category.
candidates.proof_excerpt: Because A0 is in the center of A, and d(A0) = 0, we see that M(A) is an A0- linear category. See formula (1.15). Next, from formula (2.1) we see that K(A) is an H0(A)-linear category. Hence its localization D(A) is an H0(A)-linear category.
